about_intro: Armwrestling LAB connects the questions that come up at the table with research on strength, tendons, nutrition and measurement. This library turns selected channel videos and their source reports into articles you can read, check and revisit.
approach_1: Each article is based on a supplied video transcript. Relevant PDF reports and published research provide the scientific context. Exercise demonstrations that cannot be reliably interpreted from text are not turned into tutorials.
approach_2: Reported data, calculated examples and conceptual summaries are labelled separately. Personal experience is not presented as a controlled trial, and findings in knees or engineered tissues are not treated as proven wrist protocols.
approach_3: Numbered references link the discussion to publications. Original supplied PDFs are available alongside relevant articles. The figures explain their population, units and limitations.
language_intro: Polish and English are complete in this edition. The following additional language editions are planned, not published translations:
editorial_title: An editorial synthesis, not a transcript
editorial_text: The articles combine the channel material with its evidence, rather than reproducing every claim from the narration. The wording preserves uncertainty where the data do not establish cause, a universal dose or a safe individual training load. Publication and edition dates are not presented as video upload dates.
corrections_text: For a content question, use the linked video discussion. Include the article title and the reference or figure concerned. Some video links lead to a clearly labelled topic search because the supplied archive did not include all video addresses.
privacy_title: A simple site. A small footprint.
privacy_intro: The site itself does not use analytics, advertising pixels, account systems or embedded social feeds.
privacy_storage: Theme and language preferences may be saved in localStorage. They are not sent to this site or shared with a third party. Search runs in your browser; it does not send search terms to a search service. Search terms may be included in the page address.
privacy_external: YouTube and research-publisher links open external websites with their own policies. No YouTube player is loaded automatically. The hosting provider may process ordinary request logs such as IP address and requested page. That is separate from the site code.
privacy_offline: Articles, charts, search and bundled downloads work from the extracted folder. Videos and external publications need an internet connection. This is a description of this version of the site, not a claim about every future hosting configuration.
